message: 櫛の歯

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? What are you doing at the girls' dorm, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. Are you patrolling the school grounds?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Me... ahahaha, I'm just taking a little break.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh yeah, did you know? The dorm actually has a men's restroom, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「So I bet in a few years, it'll become a co-ed student dormitory.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, dorm life sounds pretty interesting. It'd be nice if I could move in by the time I'm a third-year...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, next year is definitely still too soon.」

name: Ria
message: 「Next year, huh...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun.」

name: Ria
message: 「When I was a first-year, a friend of mine lived in Miroteia Dormitory.」

name: Ria
message: 「But before Kirafes... before the Charity Bazaar started, she quit due to family circumstances.」

name: Ria
message: 「All sorts of rumors went around--that she moved to a faraway town, or that she was still living in Ryuusei Town--but I haven't heard from her since...」

name: Ria
message: 「I haven't seen her in ages, yet she's still my friend.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if we stay apart forever like this, she's still my friend.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, Synn-kun. Not offering any clumsy words of comfort right now gets you a passing grade\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「I simply couldn't do anything other than stay quiet.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's plenty for me, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「In exchange, if you don't keep a proper eye on Nanaka-chan, Misa-chan, and Lolotte-chan, I'm gonna flick you on the forehead, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to go check on Prier for a bit. There was a suggestion box note about it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Take care. I'm going to stay here a little longer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure you come by later too, Senpai. After all, it's still this year.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, okaay.」
Keeping my back to the girls' dorm, I run without looking back even once.
Looking at Ria-senpai right now would probably be terribly rude...
